title: Input-conditioned NTK feature generator with Mirror task coordinate
hypothesis: A small Mirror coordinate generated from task descriptors will produce task-adaptive features without task-specific parameters, preserving heldout function quality while using fewer complete bytes or inference operations than the native no-task-storage NTK-CL feature generator.

world.teacher: linear task descriptor to shared feature readout

development.tuning: none; solve shared descriptor-conditioned readout by least squares

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after exact native generator alias or strict gate miss.

metrics: seen and unseen descriptor heldout nRMSE

paid_objects: task codes or descriptors if persisted

success_gate: PASS only if Mirror-generated coordinates preserve seen/unseen nRMSE <=0.02 and strictly reduce complete model+task-state bytes or adaptation/inference compute versus native no-task-storage generator without increasing task-specific persistent parameters.
failure_gate: FAIL if the generated coordinate is identical to native input conditioning, adds bytes without quality/compute benefit, or fails the quality gate.
boundaries: Synthetic linear task family only; no trained NTK-CL or PEFT evidence.
Task descriptors are supplied as inference inputs; no inference-time code inferred from raw support set is tested.
Unseen descriptor tests interpolation in a known linear task family, not unseen task-family generalization.
Fresh seeds remain sealed after alias or gate miss.
